task.label: sign of the forward close-to-close return
task.band: none -- there is no FLAT class and no row is converted into a direction

crossVenue.note: two exchanges are two order books; this measures whether they are quoting the same instrument, not whether either is 'correct'

preRegisteredGates.aboveTestMajority: accuracy strictly above the test fold's own larger class
preRegisteredGates.bothDirectionsPredicted: neither predicted class above 0.80 of the test fold
preRegisteredGates.bootstrapExcludesZero: 95% day-blocked bootstrap interval for (accuracy - majority) strictly above zero
preRegisteredGates.walkForwardMajority: above its own block majority in at least 4 of 5 chronological blocks

limitations: The test fold is a historical holdout. It is unseen by this fit, and it is still a backtest: no forecast in it was made before the data existed.
Direction only. No transaction cost, spread, funding or slippage is in any number here, and nothing here is a profitability claim.
Binance USDT pairs. The cross-venue check in the corpus manifest records how far these closes sit from a second exchange's.
